title: Merge Intervals
prompt: Given an array of intervals where `intervals[i] = [start_i, end_i]`, merge all overlapping intervals and return an array of the non-overlapping intervals that cover all the intervals in the input.
constraints: Each interval is [start, end] with start <= end.
hints: Sorting the intervals by start time first makes overlaps easy to detect in one pass.
Walk through the sorted intervals, and merge into the last interval in your result if the current one overlaps it.
Two intervals overlap when the next interval's start is <= the current merged interval's end.
